skill.summary: Use pymatgen for crystal structures, phase diagrams, electronic structure analysis, and Materials Project workflows.

security_audit.summary: Static alerts were reviewed in context and are false positives from Markdown examples, normal pymatgen imports, documented API setup, or user-requested CLI outputs. content.value_statement: Materials workflows require careful structure handling, format conversion, and database queries. This skill guides pymatgen usage for reproducible computational materials analysis.
actual_capabilities: Explains pymatgen core classes for structures, lattices, molecules, elements, and compositions.
Provides examples for reading, writing, and converting CIF, POSCAR, XYZ, JSON, and YAML files.
Guides symmetry, neighbor, phase diagram, surface, adsorption, and electronic structure analysis.
Documents Materials Project API setup, queries, filtering, batching, and local result caching.
Includes helper scripts for structure conversion, structure analysis, and phase diagram generation.
Shows VASP input set workflows for relaxation, static, band structure, surface, and screening tasks.
limitations: It depends on local pymatgen and optional scientific Python packages being installed.
Materials Project queries require a valid user API key and network access.
It provides workflow guidance, not guarantees about calculation accuracy or convergence.
Large structures and high-throughput searches may need separate resource planning.

use_cases.title: Convert Structure Files
use_cases.description: Move structures between CIF, POSCAR, XYZ, JSON, YAML, and other pymatgen-supported formats.

use_cases.title: Screen Materials Stability
use_cases.description: Build phase diagrams and compare compositions using Materials Project entries and pymatgen analysis tools.

use_cases.title: Prepare Simulation Inputs
use_cases.description: Generate consistent VASP input sets for relaxation, static, non-self-consistent, surface, and doped-structure workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pymatgen to read my structure file and summarize formula, lattice parameters, density, and space group.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this structure from CIF to POSCAR and explain any format assumptions pymatgen makes during conversion.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Stability
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Li-Fe-O phase diagram with Materials Project data and assess whether LiFeO2 is stable.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a pymatgen workflow for dopant screening, VASP input generation, phase stability checks, and result organization.

output_examples.output: A concise report with formula, lattice type, volume, density, symmetry, Wyckoff positions, and nearest-neighbor observations.

output_examples.input: Generate a phase diagram for Li-Fe-O and analyze LiFeO2.
output_examples.output: A stability summary listing stable phases, energy above hull, decomposition products, and recommended follow-up checks.

output_examples.input: Prepare VASP inputs for a doped oxide screening study.
output_examples.output: A stepwise workflow covering substitutions, supercells, input sets, folder layout, convergence checks, and provenance tracking.

best_practices: Validate structures before analysis by checking oxidation states, site occupancies, and unreasonable interatomic distances.
Use context managers for Materials Project sessions and avoid printing API keys in logs.
Keep generated calculation folders, cached API data, and transformed structures organized with clear provenance.
anti_patterns: Do not assume automatic format detection is correct when file extensions or headers are ambiguous.
Do not treat Materials Project stability data as a substitute for convergence checks in new calculations.
Do not store private API keys in shared scripts, notebooks, repositories, or exported examples.

faq.question: Does this skill install pymatgen automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and examples, but installation must be performed in the user environment.

faq.question: Can it access Materials Project data?
faq.answer: Yes, when mp-api is installed and the user provides a valid Materials Project API key.

faq.question: Which file formats are covered?
faq.answer: The references cover common pymatgen formats such as CIF, POSCAR, CONTCAR, XYZ, JSON, YAML, and VASP outputs.

faq.question: Can it generate VASP input files?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents pymatgen input sets for relaxation, static, band structure, and related calculation workflows.

faq.question: Does it run expensive simulations?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare and analyze workflows, but external simulation software performs the calculations.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
